'''Henryk Sawistowski''' (11 February 1925 – 19 December 1984)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Rocznik Grudziądzki T.17 |url=https://kpbc.ukw.edu.pl/dlibra/plain-content?id=150998 |access-date=2024-01-11 |website=kpbc.ukw.edu.pl |pages=215–217}}</ref> was a Polish-born British academic.

He was born in 1925 in [[Grudziądz]], [[Poland]].{{fact|date=April 2025}}

Sawistowski started his education in Grudziądz, during World War II while in military service. After the war he moved to London, England.{{fact|date=April 2025}}

In 1974, after earning a diploma he became a lecturer at his school - the [[Imperial College London]] gradually rising the ranks to vice-president of [[Institution of Chemical Engineers]] in 1981 and dean of [[City and Guilds]] college until his death in 1984.{{fact|date=April 2025}}
